{{Quote|As a veteran TIE pilot, I understand that the Rebellion is a vile movement against the true government, but in all honesty I have to respect the aggressiveness and ability of its pilots. Though most of them have not been formally trained, their experience in battle has more than made up for it.|[[Flight leader/Legends|Flight Leader]] [[Trel Skutu]]|<ref name="SW Trilogy Sourcebook SE">''[[Star Wars Trilogy Sourcebook, Special Edition]]''</ref>}}
The '''Alliance Starfighter Corps''', also referred to as the '''Rebel Air Force''', was headed by [[Jan Dodonna/Legends|Jan Dodonna]] and consisted of the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] in the [[Alliance Military/Legends|Alliance Military]]. Ranks, like its [[Republic Starfighter Corps/Legends|predecessor]], were generally the same as the [[Alliance Army/Legends|army]]. The Alliance Starfighter Corps participated in many battles such as the [[Assault on Kamino]], the [[Battle of Toprawa]], the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] and other successful Alliance victories and they often cordinated alongside [[Ordnance and Supply/Legends|Ordnance and Supply]] by protecting rebel supply routes and escorting supply fleets to their destination. [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron's]] efforts at the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] helped the Alliance evacuate from [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] and ensured its survival. Even though they were not starfighters, Rebel [[GR-75 medium transport/Legends|GR-75 medium transport]] were a common sight in starfighter taskforces and missions as they served as long-range fuel tankers and depots. Following the [[Declaration of a New Republic/Legends|Declaration of a New Republic]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], it was reorganized into the [[New Republic Starfighter Corps/Legends|New Republic Starfighter Corps]]. It was well-noted that a majority of its fighters were -wing craft. Notable pilots in starfighter corps are [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]], and [[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu]]. Major starfighter producers for the corps included [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]], [[Isis/Legends|Isis]], and [[Chardaan/Legends|Chardaan]].
